A.title: A · How a lead enters the Follow-Up Board
entries: Follow-up or two-call close no-show → Warm, next-day touch
Call ended with a follow-up date (said on the call, or Daniel types it in the EOD; 'next week' = next Monday, 'next month' = the 1st, none said = call + 7 days)
Two-call close or follow-up call held, no close, no new date
flow: Pipeline (Follow-Up Board, Warm, Next Touch date)
exits: Closed (Closed tab or payment confirmation email)

B.title: B · Email sequence
B.end: Gone Cold - no reply after the full sequence

C.title: C · Branches / rules
items: Lead replies → touch count resets to 0, restart Email 1 cadence, next touch = reply + 5 days. Daniel answers replies himself.
New call booked → leaves the sequence → Hot (Upcoming Calls); after the call, re-enters fresh.
Daniel says 'cold' → Gone Cold immediately. Daniel says 'Lost' / 'no follow-up' → Lost.

D.title: D · How each email is made and sent
steps: Each morning: find leads due today (green) or overdue (red) on the Pipeline Follow-Up Board
Pull context: Fathom recap, objection, 'Where It Stands', center name, past thread
Write a personalized email from that stage's prompt
Send as a REPLY in the lead's existing Gmail thread from daniel.salinas@scaledaycares.com (green 'pipe' label)
Pipeline updates itself: Last Touch, Touches +1, Next Touch; row goes uncolored
notes: Approval: Daniel reviews drafts at first, then auto-send once trusted
Writer: Grok (default) vs ChatGPT (side-by-side test pending)

E.title: E · Text lane
E.status: SMS / iMessage via GoHighLevel - waiting on A2P approval

router.title: Lead enters a sequence
router.note: Router: each lead goes into ONE branch based on why they need follow-up. Every branch reuses the same architecture (entry → emails → branches/exits).

branches.name: Branch 1: No-Show / Follow-Up Pending
branches.when: No-show on a follow-up or two-call close, or call ended without a close (follow-up date / undecided)

branches.name: Branch 2: Two-Call Close Nurture
branches.when: Two-call close booked (Grape event on the calendar)

branches.name: Branch 3: Call Confirmation (pre-call show-up)
branches.when: Any call booked - extra layer on top of the appointment setter

branches.name: Branch 4+: more coming (TBD)
branches.when: Other lead categories - Daniel to define

B3.title: Branch 3 · Call Confirmation (pre-call show-up)
B3.status: Architecture TBD - Daniel to define. Email + SMS lane, runs before the call as an extra layer on top of the appointment setter (not fully reliable).
checkpoints: Acknowledged they have the call link

B2.title: Branch 2 · Two-Call Close Nurture
B2.entry: Two-call close booked (Grape / purple event on Daniel's calendar)
